name: Tower Defense 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Tower Defense is a casual game where strategic prowess is put to the test as you build walls, erect towers, and expand your kingdom to defend against relentless hordes of enemies. As the ruler of your realm, you must harness your resources wisely, fortify your defenses, and lead your forces to victory against the encroaching threat.
